ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, headings, iconography, dark surface anchors — the single high-contrast ink that drives every readable element

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on chromatic fills, inset highlight wash

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Soft surface wash for alternating bands and section backgrounds, secondary card fills

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Inset shadow color for glassy device-frame depth

pebble-gray.$description: Pebble Gray — Muted surface for neutral feature phone frames and de-emphasized panels

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary body text, helper labels, quiet UI annotations — a near-gray that recedes without vanishing

true-black.$description: True Black — Deepest dark fill for illustration cores, icon glyphs, and shadow bases on device renders

tangerine.$description: Tangerine — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

hot-pink.$description: Hot Pink — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Decorative accent wash, soft highlight blocks in feature sections, illustration glow companion

coral-edge.$description: Coral Edge — Warm accent stroke and text highlight — used sparingly as a coral border or inline emphasis; Orange-to-pink gradient for diagonal brand ribbons, feature section backdrops, and decorative dividers

cotton-sky.$description: Cotton Sky — Radial mint-to-lavender gradient anchoring product showcase sections — dissolves into Cloud Gray at the edges

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Radial blue-to-lavender gradient for hero atmosphere and soft section transitions

prism-wash.$description: Prism Wash — Full multi-stop rainbow linear gradient — the signature 9-stop sweep used in feature bands and illustration environments

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

sf-pro-rounded.$description: Button labels and emphasized inline links — 16px is the standard action-label size, tight -0.01em tracking
